content: Kawo Dawiti keehi cimmida gishshas izas ooththizayti iza meegoppe ashshanaas may7o iza bolla koriin aykkoka iza ho7anaas dandaybeenna.
Hessa gishshas izas ooththizayti, «Kawoo! Nenara de7ashe nena lo7eththa naagana mala issi geela7o nees koyi ehinoo? Iza nenara aqikko nena ho7ana» gida.
Isra7eele biitta ubbaan koyidi Abishaago geetettiza issi mala lo7o geela7iyo Suneme katamappe demmidi kawozas ehida.
Izakka keeha mala lo7o; kawozara dashe izas ooththashe iza lo7eththa oykkadus; gido attiin izi izo ekkibeenna.
Kawotanaas Adoniyaasa Kosh
Hagiti naa Adoniyaasi, «Ta kawotana koyays» gi dendides; para-gaaretanne parata qasseka izappe sinththe sinththe baanaas 50 asata giigsides.
Iza aawaykka, «Ays hayssaththo ooththay?» gi mulekka seeri erenna. Adoniyaasi keehippe mala lo7o asa; izi Abeseloomes kaalo isha.
Adoniyaasi Xuriya naa Iyo7aaberanne qeese Abiyaataarera ha yo7oza zorettides; isttika iza maaddanaas qofa qachchida.
Gido attiin qeese Saadooqey, Yoodahe naa Bannayay, nabe Naataaney, Shim7ey, Era7eynne Dawite naagiza zabeti iza qofaa ekkibeettenna.
Issi gallas Adoniyaasi En-Roogeele katama matan Zoheleete Zaalla
geetettizason dorsata, booratanne ohala marata yarshides. Kawo nayta, ba ishata kawo shuume gidida Yuhuda asata ubbaa xeygides.
Gido attiin nabe Naataane, Bannaya, kawo naagiza zabetanne ba isha Solomoone xeygibeenna.
Solomoone Kawoteth
Hessafe guye Naataaney Solomoone aayo Bersaabeho, «Nu godaa Dawiti erontta dishin Hagiti naa Adoniyaasi kawotidayssa ne siyabeekkii?
Ha7i neni ne shempponne ne naaza Solomoone shemppo wostta ashshanaakko ane ta nena zorays.
Kawo Dawitekko baada, ‹Kawoo, ta godawu! Taas ne aylleys ne naa Solomooney taappe guyen kawotana; ta araatankka izi uttana gaada caaqqabeekkii? Histtiin Adoniyaasi waani kawotidee?› ga oychcha.
Neni kawozara heen haasayan dishin ta gelada ne gidayssi tumu gididayssa qonccisana» gides.
Suneme katamappe yida Abishaaga cimmida kawoza heemmiza ilpinne giddo Bersaabeha kawoza haasayssanaas geladus.
Bersaabeha kawoza sinththan zaqullada ba kushe denththadus; qasseka iza sinththan gulbatadus. Kawozikka izo, «Ay koyay?» giidi oychchides.
Bersaabeha izas, «Ta godawu! Taas ne aylleys, ‹Taappe guyen ne naa Solomooney kawotana; ta araatankka izi uttana› gaada GODAAN, ne Xoossan neni caaqqadasa.
Gido attiin ha7i Adoniyaasi kawotides; neni ta goday kawoy hessa erakka.
Izi keehi daro meheta, ohala maratanne dorsata yarshides; Yarshishe kawo nayta ubbaa, qeese Abiyaataarenne ola gadawa Iyo7aabe xeygides; gido attiin ne aylleza Solomoone xeygibeenna.
Ta godawu, kawoo! Neeppe guye ne kawoteththa araatan ooni uttanaakko eranaas Isra7eele asaa ubbaa ayfey nena xeelli uttides.
Histtontta aggiko ta godaa kawoy hayqqidi ba aawatan gayttiza wode taninne ta naa Solomooney mooro ooththida asa mala qoodettana» gadus.
Bersaabeha buro kawozara haasayan dishin nabe Naataaney gakki wodhdhides.
Kawozas, «Nabe Naataaney yides» giidi yootida; izikka kawoza sinththan gufannidi ba kushe denththides.
Hessafe guye Naataaney, «Ta godaa kawoo! Neeppe guye Adoniyaasi kawotana malanne ne araatan uttana mala erisadii?

Hach izi duge biidi keehi daro meheta, ohala maratanne dorsata yarshishe kawo nayta ubbaa, ola gadawatanne qeese Abiyaataare xeygides; izi ha7i izara mishenne uyishe, ‹Kawo Adoniyaasi mernaas kawoto!› geeththa bolla deettes.
Gido attiin tana ne aylle, qeese Saadooqe, Yoodahe naa Bannayanne ne aylle Solomoone xeygibeenna.
Ta godaa kawoo! Neeppe guyera ne kawoteththa araatan ooni uttanaakko ne aylleta erisontta dashe hayssa Adoniyaasi kawotana mala ooththiday nenee?» gides.
Histtiin Kawo Dawiti, «Bersaabeho taas xeygite» gides; izakka kawozi dizaso gelada iza sinththan eqqadus.
He wode kawozi izis, «Tana meto ubbaafe ashshida de7o GODAY beyiin!
GODAAN, Isra7eele Xoossan tani nees caaqqida caaqoza tumu hach polana; taappe guyen ne naa Solomooney kawotana; ta kawoteththa araatan izi uttana» gi caaqqides.
Bersaabeha kawoza sinththan gufannada ba kushe denththadus; «Ta godaa, Kawo Dawiti mernaas kawoto!» gadus.
Hessafe guye Kawo Dawiti, «Taas qeese Saadooqe, nabe Naataanenne Yoodahe naa Bannaya xeygite» gides; histtiin istti kawoza sinth shiiqida.
Kawozi isttas, «Ta aylleta inttenara ekki biidi ta naa Solomoone ta baqulo togisidi duge Giyoone efte.
Heen qeese Saadooqeynne nabe Naataaney iza tiydi Isra7eele asaa bolla kawoththetto; hessafe guye zaye punnidi intte qaala dhoqqu histtidi, ‹Kawo Solomooney mernaas kawoto!› giite.
Hessafe guye intte iza azhabidi haa pude kezite; izi yiidi ta kawoteththa araatan utto; izi ta sohon uttidi deraa aysso; tani Isra7eele deraa bollanne Yuhuda deraa bolla iza shuumadis» gides.
Yoodahe naa Bannayay kawozas zaaridi, «Amiin! Ta godaa kawoza, GODAY, Xoossay minththo!
GODAY, ta godaa kawozara gidida mala Solomoonerakka gido; iza kawoteththaa araata ta godaa kawo Dawite araataappeka aaththidi gitaso» gides.
Hessa gishshas qeese Saadooqey, nabe Naataaney, Yoodahe naa Bannayay, Kelitetinne Peliteti Solomoone Kawo Dawite baqulo togisidi duge Giyoone azhabi efida.
Qeese Saadooqey Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneppe zayte kaceza ekkidi Solomoone tiydi kawoththides; hessafe guye zaye punnida; ubba asaykka ba qaala dhoqqu histtidi, «Kawo Solomooney mernaas kawoto!» gida.
Asay ubbayka iza azhabidi pude bides; istti dinke punni punni kaa7ishe keehi ufayettida; asaa homboceththan biittay qaaxxides.
Adoniyaasinne izara diza imaththati gibira mi wursishe hessa siyida; Iyo7aabey dinkeza giirissaa siyidi, «Hayssi katamaan seetettiza giirissay aazee?» gi oychchides.
Izi buro haasayan dishin qeese Abiyaataare naa Yoonataaney gakki wodhdhides. Histtiin Adoniyaasi, «Ane haa gela; ne mala ammanettida asi lo7o wore ekki yontta aggenna» gides.
Yoonataaneykka zaaridi, «Chii, yo7oy mulekka hessa mala gidenna; nu goday kawo Dawiti Solomoone kawoththides.
Iza azhabana mala kawoy qeese Saadooqe, nabe Naataane, Yoodahe naa Bannaya, Kelitetanne Peliteta izara yeddides; istti iza kawaa baqulo togisida.
Qeese Saadooqeynne nabe Naataaney, Giyoonen iza tiydi kawoththida; heeppe istti hombocishe pude bida; hessan katamay kooshumees; ha7i intte siyiza kooshunchchay hessa.
Hessafe bollarakka Solomooney kawoteththa araatan uttides.

Qasse kawo shuumeti nu godaa kawo Dawitekko yiidi, ‹Ne Xoossay Solomoone sunththaa ne sunththaafe dhoqqu histto! Iza kawoteththa araataakka neyssafe aadheth histto!› giidi anjjida; histtiin kawoy ba algan dishe hokki Xoossas goynnishe,
‹Ta kawoteththa araatan uttidi ta sohon kawotizayssa tana hach ta ayfen bessida GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay galatetto!› gides» gi yootides.
Hessa siyidi Adoniyaasi xeygida imaththati ubbay dagammi dendidi laalettida.
Adoniyaasi gidikko Solomoones yayyidi bi yarshizasoza kaceta oykkides.

Hessafe guye asay Solomoones, «Adoniyaasi kawo Solomoones yayyidi yarshizasoza kaceta oykkidi, ‹Kawo Solomooney tana ba aylleza giththa mashshan wodhdhontta mala taas hach caaqqo› gees» giidi yootida.
Solomooney zaaridi, «Izi ba hemeth lo7eththiko haray attoshin iza hu7e binanappe issinakka gaden wodhdhuku; gido attiin iza bolla iitateththi beettiko izi hayqqana» gides.
Hessafe guye kawo Solomooney as kiittiin istti biidi iza yarsho yarshizasoppe duge woththida; histtiin Adoniyaasi yiidi Solomoones ziggides; Solomooneykka iza, «Gede neso ba» gides.

Kelitetinne Peliteti kawo keeth naaganaas doorettidaytara naagiza kare dereppe qaxxarettidayta bessees. 2Same 8:18, 20:23, 1 Same 30:14 xeella.
